dialogue.speaker: Samwise Gamgee
dialogue.text: There's barely a sip left in the flask, Mr. Frodo, and only two crusts of bread. If we eat them now, we'll have nothing left for the walk back.

dialogue.speaker: Frodo Baggins
dialogue.text: There won't be a walk back, Sam. We have just enough strength to reach Mount Doom and destroy the Ring. After that, nothing else matters.

dialogue.speaker: Samwise Gamgee
dialogue.text: Don't talk like that. We didn't come all this way across Mordor just to lie down and die once the job is done.

dialogue.speaker: Frodo Baggins
dialogue.text: Look around you, Sam. There is no food, no water, and hundreds of miles of ash between us and home.

dialogue.speaker: Samwise Gamgee
dialogue.text: Then we take it one step at a time. Drink the last of the water now, Mr. Frodo—we'll worry about tomorrow after the Ring is in the fire.

dialogue.speaker: Frodo Baggins
dialogue.text: You never stop hoping, do you, Sam? Very well. Help me up, and let's finish what we came to do.
